name: Class Diagram
description: Class Diagram describes the static structure of the system through classes, interfaces, attributes, methods, and their relationships. This is a fundamental diagram when designing domain models, ORM entities, or object-oriented architecture.
purpose: Describe the static structure of the system, design the domain model, and define relationships between classes/entities.
bestFor: Design data structure for RDBMS via ORM (Spring Boot / Hibernate, Entity Framework)
Describe Domain Model in Domain-Driven Design
Analyze, refactor, or reverse-engineer object-oriented source code
Create technical documentation for relationships between entities, services, and interfaces
notSuitableFor: Describe specific objects at runtime → use Object Diagram
Describe function/API call order over time → use Sequence Diagram
Describe business workflow → use Activity Diagram
useCases: Identify list of classes/entities/interfaces in the system
Define attributes with data types and visibility
Define methods with parameters and return types
Draw relationships: Association, Generalization, Realization, Composition, Aggregation, Dependency

confusableWith.difference: Class Diagram describes blueprint/type; Object Diagram describes specific instances at runtime.
Class Diagram describes classes; Package Diagram describes package/module groups and dependencies.
Class Diagram at code/object model level; Component Diagram at module/service/subsystem level.
